summary: All seven estimates are supported by the saved 40-page accepted manuscript. Read the entire markdown conversion in chunks, including references and Appendix 1, and extracted the cited PDF pages directly with PyMuPDF. Confirmed every recorded mean, SD, test statistic, degree of freedom, p-value, effect size, and analyzed arm count against its cited page and the correct outcome and arms. Table 2 on PDF p. 16 supports the three unadjusted comparisons; the H1 paragraph on p. 16 supports the three treatment ANCOVAs; p. 17 supports the full-sample originality group-by-task interaction. All eight supplied script alerts are false positives: PDF p. 16 explicitly prints F(1,142) = 19.07 for quality, F(1,142) = 14.87 for elaboration, and F(1,142) = 12.56 for originality; PDF p. 17 prints F(1,142) = 7.79 for the interaction. Both degrees of freedom are also present in each recorded quote. The experimental and control counts are 77 and 68 on PDF p. 11; p. 10 states that all participants completed all required tasks and none were excluded. The combined participant total is not printed and is correctly left null. The procedure, scoring definitions, appendix rubric, and participant-level analyses support the question, construct, measure, unit, higher_is, outcome_with_ai, outcome_timing, within_person, comparison_type, and se_basis coding. The interaction compares changes between randomized groups; it is not a randomized-order crossover. The partial eta-squared interpretation is explicitly preserved in the effect notes. Figure 1 was inspected in memory: it has no numerical arm estimates or interval endpoints to transcribe. No eligible outcome or full-sample contrast is missing under extraction rules 4-6. Baseline-only results, self-reports, self-evaluation bias, completion time, covariate associations, and within-arm correlations are appropriately excluded. The seven records share one sample and are overlapping specifications.
